<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent_macro "<!ENTITY ent 'resolved-entity'>">
  %ent_macro;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY bin SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment testing parser paths -->
  <?target data="processing-instruction-value"?>
  <child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with entities &ent; and tags <child> ]]>
  </child>
  <sub:item>&ent;</sub:item>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ENTITY inner 'parameter-expanded'>">
  %p1;
  <!ENTITY ref "&inner; and more">
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://xml.org/math">
  <!-- Section comment with some special chars <>& -->
  <section id="s1">
    <?pi-target data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nesting CDATA: &ref; <m:math></m:math>
    ]]>
    <m:sub>&ref;</m:sub>
  </section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY copyright "Public Domain">
  <!ENTITY % ext_dtd SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %ext_dtd;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="print.css"?>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog:root" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Catalog comment block -->
  <book xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <title>XML Guide</title>
    <author>John Doe</author>
    <![CDATA[
      Some ©right; notes inside CDATA section.
    ]]>
  </book>
</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY gen "Generated Text">
  <!ENTITY complex "&gen; -> nested">
  <!NOTATION n SYSTEM "sys-notation">
  <!ENTITY ent-ndata SYSTEM "file.bin" NDATA n>
]>
<?pi-data test="processing"?>
<archive xmlns="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/archive/" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment in archive namespace context -->
  <record xsi:nil="true">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA containing &complex; and unparsed reference handling.
    ]]>
  </record>
</archive>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY opt1 "enabled">
  <!ENTITY opt2 "disabled">
  <!ENTITY % batch "<!ENTITY combined '&opt1;/&opt2;'>">
  %batch;
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose"?>
<config xmlns="http://config.org/ns" xmlns:cfg="http://config.org/ns/cfg">
  <!-- Configuration parameters comment -->
  <setting cfg:name="mode">&combined;</setting>
  <cfg:setting>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- HTML-like comment inside CDATA -->
      Value: &combined;
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
</config>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE enterprise [
  <!ELEMENT enterprise (department*)>
  <!ELEMENT department (employee*)>
  <!ELEMENT employee (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY corp "MegaCorp">
  <!ENTITY % local_entities "<!ENTITY branch 'Global'>">
  %local_entities;
]>
<?xml-timestamp date="2023-10-01"?>
<enterprise xmlns="http://enterprise.org/ns" xmlns:hr="http://enterprise.org/ns/hr">
  <!-- Enterprise hierarchy comment -->
  <department hr:code="HQ">
    <employee>
      <![CDATA[
        &branch; division of &corp;
      ]]>
    </employee>
  </department>
</enterprise>
```

<!DOCTYPE library [
  <!ELEMENT library (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY b1 "Book One">
  <!ENTITY b2 "Book Two: &b1;">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY ebook SYSTEM "sample.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-space preserve?>
<library xmlns="http://library.org/ns" xmlns:bib="http://library.org/ns/bib">
  <!-- Library inventory comment -->
  <book bib:category="fiction">
    <![CDATA[
      Internal CDATA with entity reference &b2;
    ]]>
  </book>
  <book>&b2;</book>
</library>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (test*)>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pass "SUCCESS">
  <!ENTITY fail "FAILURE">
  <!ENTITY % result_macro "<!ENTITY outcome '&pass;'>">
  %result_macro;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<suite xmlns="http://qa.org/suite" xmlns:tr="http://qa.org/suite/tr">
  <!-- Test suite execution logs comment -->
  <test tr:id="T001">
    <![CDATA[
      Test execution result: &outcome;
    ]]>
  </test>
  <tr:test>&outcome;</tr:test>
</suite>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>

  <!ENTITY itemB "Widget B: &itemA;">

]>
<?xml-summary type="html"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://shop.org/ns" xmlns:inv="http://shop.org/ns/inv">
  <!-- Inventory stock comment -->
  <item inv:sku="12345">
    <![CDATA[
      Detailed description for &itemB; with <tags> inside.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&itemB;</item>
</inventory>

</report>
